nLevels.description: Number of levels. Code MUST read this (do not hardcode the level count).

enemyCount.description: Enemies present at once in a level (level 1 baseline). Spawn loops MUST read this, not a literal.

enemySpeedFactor.description: Enemy speed as a fraction of player speed.

hazardCount.description: Static hazards (spikes/pits/traps) per level. Hazard-placement loops MUST read this.

timeLimitSec.description: Per-level time limit in seconds (0 = no limit). The level timer MUST read this.

uiPalette._comment: Fixed-UI-chrome theme. Set these from the game's visual_mood (hex strings). The chrome owns layout; these only recolor it. Contrast is preserved regardless.
